arguments.verdict: Strong BNB-native trust and settlement layer
strengths: The problem is specific to agentic finance
The product has a short, inspectable path

arguments.verdict: Decision data is broad, but outcome history is still conditional
strengths: Freshness and source boundaries are first-class
Indexer signals and SafeHire observations remain separate
attacks: No external paid delivery has become a verified track record.
Quality evidence is still an automated baseline, not independent review.
required_changes: Complete one bounded external paid hire and attach the delivery receipt.
Complete three independent blinded output reviews.

arguments.verdict: Four-category parity is present; supplier diversity is the next proof
strengths: Every official category has a dedicated skill
The same evidence envelope can compare heterogeneous agents
attacks: All live listings currently come from one operator.
required_changes: Onboard a second independent ERC-8004 provider.

arguments.verdict: Structurally eligible, but the strongest quality claim still needs people
strengths: Raw outputs and hashes are reproducible
Financial and safety-sensitive tasks are included
attacks: The published quality delta is not independently blinded.
required_changes: Use the benchmark lab to collect three human runs and blind reviews.

arguments.verdict: Protocol-native benefit is measurable and honestly bounded
strengths: Same-block route comparisons are reproducible
Gas assumptions and execution boundaries are disclosed
attacks: The current measurable benefit is quoted, not realised by a paid external job.
required_changes: Bind one bounded hire to a fresh quote or LP decision and preserve the receipt.

arguments.verdict: Altana is correctly treated as unclaimed scope
strengths: The project does not borrow eligibility from a logo
Existing permission controls remain useful to the main track

arguments.verdict: Fail closed with independent execution authority
strengths: LLM output is advisory
Revocation, idempotency and approval are explicit
Capabilities can be replaced without rewriting the product
The deterministic execution boundary stays isolated

arguments.verdict: The remaining scope is survivable only if manual proof comes first
strengths: The product already has an end-to-end skeleton
Optional sponsor work can be deferred

arguments.verdict: Evidence is inspectable and claims are bounded
strengths: The append-only ledger catches silent edits
Live, testnet, sponsored and fixture modes are distinct
attacks: No paid external delivery can yet be audited.
required_changes: Capture the first external mainnet delivery without rewriting history.

non_negotiables: The judge path must activate a live BSC Agent without a dead end.
All four official categories must have equal, category-specific depth.
Decision data must expose source, freshness and uncertainty.
AgentProof must be deterministic and capped by evidence quality.
AI cannot bypass simulation, policy, permission or human approval.
Fixtures, sponsored analyses and paid deliveries must never be conflated.
TermiX evidence must retain three same-task raw output pairs.
Altana must not be claimed without a real session-key transaction and revocation proof.
No self-audit may be presented as an official BNB Chain score.
deferred: Additional smart contracts without a judge-visible outcome
Altana integration unless the complete live session flow can be evidenced
manual_gates: Complete one bounded external paid ERC-8183 delivery.
Complete three human no-Agent runs and independent blind reviews.
Onboard a second independent ERC-8004 provider.
Use reliable judging-period hosting and publish a focused demo.
honesty_boundary: This deterministic council accepts the product strategy; it does not certify official eligibility, adoption, independent quality or an award.

unresolved_conflicts: marketable TermiX score versus independent review
single vanity score versus criterion-level proof
